title.narrative: Procurement of Hospital Equipment, Solar Unit & Vehicles in Malawi

description.narrative:
The Embassy of Iceland is partnering with the Malawi government through program-based approaches focused on two district councils - Mangochi and Nkhotakota with the overall goal of improving the livelihoods and socio-economic living conditions of the rural communities in the two districts.

UNOPS supports these initiatives theough the procurement of hospital equipment and solar power for Makanjira CeMONC health facility in Mangochi unit, medical equipment for Kaongozi and Lupachi health centers in Nkhotakota district, and of two vehicles for Nkhotakota District Council.
